lines.speaker: hub_picker
lines.text: Eleven years this place has been shut and the pick list is still running. Drones still picking, conveyor still turning, orders from 2053 still going out to a loading bay with nothing in it. I come in for the parts and I stay well out of aisle nine.

lines.speaker: hub_picker
lines.text: Aisle nine is filing. Actual paper filing, in cabinets, under armed guard, in a distribution warehouse. Have a think about what gets filed in a shed — and then have a think about who is still paying the guard.

lines.speaker: hub_picker
lines.text: You went in. Nine pages, was it? People on this coast have been guessing about aisle nine for a decade. Some of them said weapons. And it is nine pages.
